label: TP
reason: Two distinct vulnerabilities identified: 1) Insecure randomness via java.util.Random.nextFloat() in alert-1, which is used to generate a session key without sufficient entropy; 2) XSS vulnerability in alert-2 where user-provided cookie values are directly concatenated into HTML output without encoding. Both alerts represent real security issues with data reaching sinks without proper mitigation.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness source 'new java.util.Random().nextFloat()' used to create rememberMeKey
User-provided cookie values are directly concatenated into HTML response without encoding
